metadata.title: Gromov-compactifiability of Wasserstein spaces
metadata.abstract: We characterize Gromov-compactifiability of Wasserstein spaces over Polish metric spaces for $1\leq p\leq\infty$. The space $\mathcal{P}_1(X)$ is Gromov-compactifiable if and only if $X$ is bounded and Gromov-compactifiable, whereas $\mathcal{P}_p(X)$ is Gromov-compactifiable for every $1<p<\infty$. At the other endpoint, $\mathcal{P}_\infty(X)$ is Gromov-compactifiable if and only if $X$ is. For $p=1$, the sufficiency argument combines an averaged triangle defect with tightness. For $1<p<\infty$, the main tool is the uniform convexity of $L^p$. The $p=\infty$ proof uses the finite-set criterion and a mass redistribution construction.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 刻画 Polish 度量空间上 Wasserstein 空间的 Gromov 可紧化性：p=1 要求底空间有界且可紧化，1<p<∞ 总成立，p=∞ 则等价于底空间可紧化。
analysis.breakthrough: 揭示两个端点与中间指数之间显著不同的几何行为。
analysis.limitations: Gromov 可紧化不等同于 Wasserstein 空间本身紧致，必须先核对定义。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 与度量空间及最优输运直接相关，端点差异具有方法论价值。
